text_block_list.name: Super Creek
choice_data_list: Morning! How was your day off?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You seem pretty energetic yourself.<n>Hehe, you must
have got some good<n>rest too.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Your peppy greeting and perky smile<n>are raising my
mood even more!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Let's not push ourselves too hard<n>and go at our
own pace today. And,<n>as always, let's give it our
all! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek is light on her feet and<n>looks well
rested.
